name: Pilot Stonegear
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear readies the Trollplow for battle. Called “Stone,” the dwarf mechanic and driver serves in the Ironforge Siege Brigade. He seeks rare materials to improve the machine's engine and armor, and travelers in Dun Morogh help him find them.

sections.title: Master of the Trollplow
sections.body: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear drives for Ironforge's Siege Brigade. His pride is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to break enemy lines. Stone knows a driver's life in battle depends on sound gears, strong plates, and steady steam pressure. So he keeps improving the tank's fighting power and making its cramped cockpit more livable.

sections.title: Tinkering and Metallurgy
sections.body: Off duty, Pilot Stonegear debates engineering plans with fellow pilots such as Pilot Bellowfiz. The depot's standard designs never satisfy him. He seeks unusual ores and volatile minerals to improve Trollplow's armor and munitions. Travelers cross Dun Morogh's snowy wilderness and dangerous caves to find the supplies he needs.

faq.answer: Often called “Stone,” Pilot Stonegear is a dwarf in the Ironforge Siege Brigade. At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, he maintains and drives his siege engine, Trollplow.
Pilot Stonegear is at Steelgrill's Depot, just outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Siege tanks, spare parts, and fellow pilots surround him there.
Trollplow is Pilot Stonegear's personal siege engine. He works to improve its reliability, armor, and interior comfort for front-line combat.

faq.q: What does Stonegear need adventurers for?
faq.answer: Stonegear asks travelers to scout nearby threats and gather rare minerals, including incendicite ore. He uses those supplies to maintain and improve the Siege Brigade's heavy war machines.

faq.q: Who does Pilot Stonegear work with?
faq.answer: Pilot Stonegear serves in the Ironforge Siege Brigade with drivers such as Pilot Bellowfiz and Pilot Hammerfoot. At the depot, he often discusses mechanical improvements and machine designs with Bellowfiz.

faq.q: What is the Ironforge Siege Brigade?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Siege Brigade is the dwarven military's mechanized armor division. Its steam tanks, siege engines, and heavy artillery defend Dun Morogh and project Ironforge's military might across Khaz Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can share Stonegear's love of heavy steel, roaring engines, and crushing mountain foes beneath iron treads.
As a gnome serving alongside the Siege Brigade, you may find a kindred spirit in Stonegear. He eagerly tinkers with designs and seeks greater output.
As an engineer, you can appreciate how Stonegear adapts Trollplow in the field, balancing combat power with the driver's comfort.
As a miner, you can supply the raw ores and volatile underground deposits Stonegear needs for reinforced plating and munitions.
